body: Real bug: Raccoon's dash gates on dodge_cooldown, the generic turnip fallback right after it gates on turnip_cooldown (a different field Raccoon never touches, always 0) -- dash on cooldown fell through to spawn a turnip anyway, breaking Raccoon's no-offense identity. Fixed by excluding all 4 custom-special characters explicitly from the fallback rather than relying on coincidental shared gating fields. Regression test added (5/5). Commit BRAWLPIT 5db7468.
title: Fix Raccoon special-move fallthrough into generic turnip
